title: 加息预期升温：盈利却更强，工业板块能否继续领跑？
speaker: Kevin Gordon

segments.en: Yeah, that's a great question. I think, you know, we're pretty comfortable that, you know, we believed coming into the year. We were kind of done raising rates. I do think we've adjusted going into mid year, thinking that rates will increase. I think the equity markets have adjusted as well.
segments.zh: 好问题。年初我们认为加息已结束，但年中我们调整了预期，认为利率会上升。权益市场也已相应调整。

segments.en: But I would say they've adjusted because earnings growth has been incredibly strong. And obviously we're in one of the biggest innovation cycles we've ever been in. And I do think a lot of that continues. But rather than just focus on very narrow areas of the market like technology, we are much more focused on where AI could bring more efficiency and more, you know, more gains in the future.
segments.zh: 市场调整是因为盈利增长非常强劲，我们正处于最大的创新周期之一。我们认为这将继续。但我们更关注AI能带来效率提升和未来收益的领域，而非仅仅聚焦科技等狭窄板块。

segments.en: And I do think that there are industries that stand out to that. And the industrial has been a winner this year so far. We still really like that sector. I would just move down cap a little bit. There's a little bit more opportunity. I think multiples are better looking in the small and mid cap space for industrial. But I think they sit at a really interesting intersection, not only of the AI spend, but also of kind of the global re alignment of the supply chain.
segments.zh: 有些行业脱颖而出，工业板块今年表现领先，我们仍看好该板块。我们倾向于向中小盘倾斜，因为估值更具吸引力。工业板块处于AI支出和全球供应链重构的交汇点。

segments.en: I think that's one area of the market. We like a lot. There are others. Again, we've tended to shift a little bit more down cap. That's work for us. And again, it's a big world out there. And we do still think there's a lot of opportunity and emerging markets.
segments.zh: 这是我们非常看好的领域之一。我们倾向于向中小盘倾斜，这对我们有效。此外，全球市场广阔，我们仍认为新兴市场存在大量机遇。
